about: Read-along for How lit-html renders: which lines of lit-html.ts the narration is describing. Each entry starts at a narration mark ("scene.mark", or "scene" for the scene's start) and lasts until the next. ranges are [first, last] lines of the file below, 1-based and inclusive.

entries.title: `lit-html.ts`
entries.note: The core of lit-html is this one file, 2,303 lines at 3.3.3. The read-along follows the narration through it.

entries.title: An empty comment: `createMarker()`
entries.note: render() puts one where its part begins (L2277); lists put a pair around each item (L1711).

entries.title: The `lit$…$` comment: the template marker
entries.note: In text, the template's HTML gets `nodeMarker`, `<?lit$…$>`, and the HTML parser turns that into this comment.

entries.title: The route through the file
entries.note: The tag, render(), the template cache, prepare (getTemplateHtml, Template), create and update (TemplateInstance), and the parts.

entries.title: The `html` tag
entries.note: counter returns an html-tagged template literal. `html` is defined here.

entries.title: `render()`
entries.note: The entry point: `render(value, container, options?)`.

entries.title: Rendering again
entries.note: The first render appends; later renders to the same container update what's there.

entries.title: Three phases, one method
entries.note: `ChildPart._commitTemplateResult`: get the Template (prepare), clone it (create), set the values (update).

entries.title: Prepare
entries.note: On a template cache miss, `_$getTemplate` prepares a new Template (L1676).

entries.title: Create
entries.note: A new TemplateInstance clones the Template's DOM.

entries.title: Update
entries.note: The instance gives its parts their values. L1641 is the path that skips create.

entries.title: Skipping prepare and create
entries.note: Already showing this template: update only. Template in the cache: no prepare (L1674).

entries.title: The `html` tag
entries.note: `html` is `tag(HTML_RESULT)`: a tag function for template literals.

entries.title: A tagged template literal
entries.note: A function name right before the backtick: JavaScript calls it with the literal's pieces.

entries.title: The strings and the values
entries.note: A tag function gets the literal's fixed strings as one array, then the value of each `${…}`.

entries.title: `html` does almost nothing
entries.note: In dev mode, two checks that only warn; then it returns what it was given.

entries.title: A plain object
entries.note: `_$litType$: 1` is `HTML_RESULT` (L451): HTML, not SVG or MathML.

entries.title: `TemplateResult`
entries.note: `TemplateResult` is an alias of `UncompiledTemplateResult` (L518).

entries.title: Nothing parsed, no DOM
entries.note: A TemplateResult is only a description; `html` is lazy (L596).

entries.title: A second TemplateResult
entries.note: Every call returns a new object.

entries.title: New values
entries.note: `values` is a rest parameter (L555): a new array on every call.

entries.title: The same strings array
entries.note: JavaScript passes the same array every time this literal runs.

links.title: GetTemplateObject: one strings array per literal

entries.title: The template cache
entries.note: A WeakMap from the strings array to the prepared Template.

entries.title: `render()`
entries.note: Find or make the root part, then give it the value.

entries.title: Looking for the part
entries.note: It's stored on the container as `_$litPart$` (or on `renderBefore`, if given).

entries.title: None yet
entries.note: First render: `part` is undefined.

entries.title: A new ChildPart
entries.note: No parent, and `endNode` is null: the part's content runs to the end of the container.

entries.title: It starts at an empty comment
entries.note: `createMarker()` makes the empty comment (L368); render() inserts it into the container.

entries.title: What a ChildPart can hold
entries.note: `_$setValue`: text (L1476), a template (L1480), a node (L1497), a list (L1499).

entries.title: Stored on the container
entries.note: Next time, render() finds it at L2262.

entries.title: Given the TemplateResult
entries.note: For a TemplateResult, `_$setValue` calls `_commitTemplateResult` (L1480).

entries.title: Look up the template
entries.note: First, `_commitTemplateResult` gets the Template for this result.

entries.title: The template cache
entries.note: One WeakMap for the whole module, keyed by the strings array (read at L1674).

entries.title: A miss
entries.note: The first time, `templateCache.get(strings)` is undefined.

entries.title: The first look at the HTML
entries.note: Nothing before `new Template()` reads the strings as HTML.

entries.title: Prepare: `new Template()`
entries.note: The constructor makes the HTML (getTemplateHtml), parses it in a `<template>`, then walks it.

entries.title: Strings into DOM
entries.note: `getTemplateHtml` makes one HTML string; `createElement` parses it.

entries.title: The browser's parser
entries.note: No HTML parser of its own: the HTML goes to a `<template>` element's innerHTML.

entries.title: `getTemplateHtml()`
entries.note: Returns the HTML with a marker in each hole, and the bound attributes' names.

entries.title: A marker in each hole
entries.note: Text holes get a comment marker; attribute holes, the marker and a renamed attribute.

entries.title: Which marker
entries.note: Decided by the scanner's state at the end of each string.

entries.title: Scanning the strings
entries.note: For each string, run the current state's regex from where the last match ended.

entries.title: Three states
entries.note: `regex` is the state: `textEndRegex` in text, `tagEndRegex` in a tag, a quote regex in a quoted value.

entries.title: A handful of regexes
entries.note: Each one matches the end of the state it's named after.

entries.title: Hole 0: an attribute value
entries.note: `tagEndRegex` matched ` class="`: `attrNameEndIndex` marks where the name ends; the state becomes `doubleQuoteAttrEndRegex`.

entries.title: The marker goes in the value
entries.note: The string ends in `class="`, so `marker` lands inside the quotes.

entries.title: `$lit$` on the name
entries.note: The original name goes into `attrNames` (L937): the HTML parser lowercases attribute names.

entries.title: Easy to find
entries.note: The walk finds bound attributes by this suffix (L1012) and removes them (L1031).

entries.title: Hole 1: text
entries.note: In `">`, the closing quote returns to `tagEndRegex` (L894), then `>` to `textEndRegex` (L873).

entries.title: `<?lit$…$>`
entries.note: In text, the string gets `nodeMarker`: a question mark and the marker, between angle brackets.

entries.title: Processing-instruction syntax
entries.note: It parses as the comment `<!--?lit$…$-->`: HTML now has processing instructions, but `$` can't be in a target, so this one stays a comment.

entries.title: Hole 2: an unquoted value
entries.note: ` @click=` has no quote, so the state stays `tagEndRegex`; `attrNameEndIndex` still marks the name.

entries.title: Handled like the first
entries.note: `attrNames` is now `['class', '@click']`.

entries.title: The marker
entries.note: `lit$`, nine random digits, `$`.

entries.title: Picked once
entries.note: A module-level const: `Math.random()` runs once, when lit-html loads.

entries.title: One piece of HTML
entries.note: Each string went in with its marker (L933); the last string closes it off.

entries.title: A `<template>` element
entries.note: `Template.createElement` makes it.

entries.title: `innerHTML`
entries.note: The browser parses the HTML into the template's content, a DocumentFragment.

entries.title: Inert
entries.note: That's the platform, not lit-html. lit-html only ever copies this DOM, with importNode (L1223).

entries.title: One walk
entries.note: `walker` is one TreeWalker for the whole module; `nodeIndex` counts each node it visits (L1082).

entries.title: Elements and comments only
entries.note: 129 is `NodeFilter.SHOW_ELEMENT` (1) | `SHOW_COMMENT` (128): text nodes are never visited.

entries.title: Node 0: the span
entries.note: An element with attributes: look for names ending in `$lit$`.

entries.title: An attribute template part
entries.note: Name `'class'` from `attrNames`, strings `['', '']` from splitting the value on the marker, and no prefix: AttributePart.

entries.title: Node 1: the marker comment
entries.note: Its data is exactly `markerMatch`, `?lit$…$`.

entries.title: A child template part
entries.note: Just a type and an index. The comment isn't removed: it will mark where the part starts.

entries.title: `@` makes an EventPart
entries.note: The regex splits `'@click'` into the prefix `@` and the name `click`.

entries.title: The prefixes
entries.note: `.` PropertyPart, `?` BooleanAttributePart, `@` EventPart, none AttributePart.

entries.title: Three parts: stop
entries.note: `partCount` is `strings.length - 1`: one part per hole.

entries.title: A Template
entries.note: `el`, the `<template>`, and `parts`, the template parts.

entries.title: Into the cache
entries.note: Keyed by the strings array.

entries.title: Once per template literal
entries.note: The cache is module-level (L688): every part, and every render() call, shares it.

entries.title: Back in the root part
entries.note: `_commitTemplateResult` has its Template.

entries.title: Already showing this template?
entries.note: `_$committedValue` is what the part shows now. It starts as `nothing` (L1341).

entries.title: A TemplateInstance
entries.note: It holds the Template, and soon one Part per template part.

entries.title: `importNode`
entries.note: A deep copy of the template's content, into this document: no parsing.

entries.title: The same walk, over the copy
entries.note: The same TreeWalker, now on the fragment, counting nodes the same way.

entries.title: Stopping at each index
entries.note: The template parts are in node order, so one pass finds them all.

entries.title: Making a Part
entries.note: Each Part keeps a direct reference to its node.

entries.title: An AttributePart for the span
entries.note: `templatePart.ctor` is AttributePart here.

entries.title: A ChildPart at the comment
entries.note: `startNode` is the comment; `endNode` is its next sibling, null here.

entries.title: An EventPart for the button
entries.note: The same code as for the span, with `ctor` EventPart (its constructor: L2035).

entries.title: No more searching
entries.note: The instance keeps its Parts in `_$parts`; updates go straight to them.

entries.title: Update
entries.note: Still inside `_commitTemplateResult`, before the fragment is inserted.

entries.title: `_update(values)`
entries.note: Each part gets its value; here, part i gets `values[i]` (L1287).

entries.title: The AttributePart gets `''`
entries.note: A single-value binding, so `this.strings` is undefined (see L1853).

entries.title: Its last value: `nothing`
entries.note: The constructor set `_$committedValue` to `nothing` (L1857).

entries.title: A change: `setAttribute`
entries.note: `''` isn't `nothing`, so `_commitValue` sets `class=""`.

entries.title: The ChildPart gets `0`
entries.note: A primitive, and not the last value: commit it as text.

entries.title: A new text node
entries.note: `_commitNode` inserts it before `endNode`, which is null, so it lands right after the comment.

entries.title: The EventPart gets the handler
entries.note: EventPart has its own `_$setValue`.

entries.title: `addEventListener`
entries.note: The old listener is `nothing`, so it adds one.

entries.title: The listener is the part
entries.note: An object with `handleEvent()` can be a listener, so a new function doesn't mean a new listener.

entries.title: `handleEvent()`
entries.note: It calls the latest function, with `this` set to `options.host` or the element.

entries.title: Still detached
entries.note: The fragment from `_clone` isn't in the page yet while `_update` runs.

entries.title: Inserted at once
entries.note: `_commitNode(fragment)`: inserting a fragment moves all its children in one call.

entries.title: Remembering the instance
entries.note: Next render, L1631 compares against it.

entries.title: The second mystery comment
entries.note: `nodeMarker`, parsed into a comment in the template, then copied into the page by importNode.

entries.title: Where a child part starts
entries.note: In `_clone`, this comment became the ChildPart's `startNode`.

entries.title: A click
entries.note: `handleEvent` calls the handler, which calls `render(counter(1), document.body)`.

entries.title: A new TemplateResult
entries.note: The same strings array, new values.

entries.title: `render()` finds its part
entries.note: `part` is defined this time, so straight to `_$setValue`.

entries.title: A cache hit
entries.note: No new Template: prepare is skipped.

entries.title: Same template, same instance
entries.note: The committed instance's `_$template` is this Template.

entries.title: Create skipped
entries.note: No new TemplateInstance, no clone.

entries.title: `'odd' !== ''`
entries.note: The class value changed.

entries.title: `setAttribute`
entries.note: DOM write 1.
The number changed.

entries.title: No new text node
entries.note: The last value was a primitive, so the text node after the comment is still there.

entries.title: Its data changes
entries.note: DOM write 2: the same text node, new text.

entries.title: A new function
entries.note: Every counter() call makes a new arrow function.

entries.title: Kept
entries.note: `handleEvent` calls this one from now on.

entries.title: No listener change
entries.note: Same options (none), and the old listener isn't `nothing`: no remove, no add.

entries.title: Two DOM writes
entries.note: `setAttribute('class', 'odd')`, and `data = '1'` on the text node.

entries.title: Only the parts
entries.note: `_update` visits the instance's parts and nothing else.

entries.title: Unchanged values
entries.note: An unchanged string or number: no commit. Objects and functions always count as changes to an AttributePart (L1901).

entries.title: A template in a ChildPart
entries.note: Any ChildPart given a TemplateResult commits it as a template.

entries.title: The same method
entries.note: The root part and a nested part run the same `_commitTemplateResult`.

entries.title: A different template
entries.note: The committed instance's `_$template` isn't this one.

entries.title: Clear, and a new instance
entries.note: The new instance is made first (L1643); then `_commitNode(fragment)` (L1666) clears the old DOM and inserts the new.

entries.title: Switching back: a cache hit
entries.note: That template is still in the cache: no prepare.

entries.title: But a new instance
entries.note: The part only remembers the instance it's showing, so it clones again.

entries.title: The cache directive
entries.note: `cache()` keeps the DOM of the templates it switches away from. It's in directives/cache.ts, not this file.

entries.title: An array
entries.note: Any iterable goes to `_commitIterable`.

entries.title: A ChildPart per item
entries.note: New items get new parts; existing parts are reused by position.

entries.title: A pair of empty comments
entries.note: Each item's part gets its own start and end markers.

entries.title: The rest of the empty comments
entries.note: The same `createMarker()` that render() uses for the root part.

entries.title: Items from one template literal
entries.note: Each item's part gets a TemplateResult and handles it like any ChildPart.

entries.title: Prepared once
entries.note: The first item misses the cache; the other two hit.

entries.title: An instance each
entries.note: Each item's part creates its own TemplateInstance.

entries.title: Matched by position
entries.note: Item i reuses the part from item i of the last render; leftover parts are cleared (L1725).

entries.title: Updated in place
entries.note: Same template in the same part: just `_update`.

entries.title: The repeat directive
entries.note: `repeat()` matches items by key and moves their DOM. It's in directives/repeat.ts, not this file.

entries.title: One strings array per literal
entries.note: JavaScript's doing, not lit-html's.

links.title: GetTemplateObject: one strings array per literal

entries.title: The template cache
entries.note: Scanned and parsed once per strings array.

entries.title: Each ChildPart's instance
entries.note: Clone only when the template in that spot changes.

entries.title: Each part's last value
entries.note: An unchanged string or number never reaches the DOM.

entries.title: The empty comments
entries.note: `createMarker()`: the root part's start (L2277), and each list item's pair (L1711).

entries.title: The `lit$…$` comments
entries.note: `nodeMarker` in the template's HTML, copied into the page.

entries.title: Each starts a child part
entries.note: The copied comment is the ChildPart's `startNode`.

entries.title: Further reading
entries.note: The design doc, and this file.
